identity_anchor: Three-layered triangular play button structure (Blue outer, Green middle, Orange inner)
brand_cues_to_preserve: The specific concentric triangular arrangement of the three color bands
The central negative space forming a 'Play' triangle
The rounded, fluid curvature of the outer edges
structure_policy_rationale: The reference examples (Alipay, Bilibili) demonstrate that complex logos are preserved as exact 3D extrusions. For Tencent Video, the three overlapping triangles form a unique geometric signature that must remain intact to be recognizable. The transformation is purely material (flat vector -> 3D ice block) and chromatic (multi-color -> unified ice blue), without altering the silhouette or internal segmentation lines.
design_rationale: Tencent Video's logo is a highly recognizable geometric symbol. Following the theme's 'Identity Handling Policy', we maintain the exact shape to ensure instant recognition while applying the 'Ice/Crystal' material to unify it with the theme. The distinct layers of the original logo translate perfectly into layers of ice with varying refraction or internal bubbles, creating a natural 3D effect without needing to redesign the object.
must_preserve: The overall triangular silhouette pointing right
The internal division lines separating the three bands (rendered as grooves or internal refraction lines in the ice)
can_recompose: Original brand colors (Blue/Green/Orange) must be replaced by Ice Blue/Translucent White
Flat surfaces become volumetric with thickness (Z-axis extrusion)
Internal details can be represented by embedded snowflakes or bubbles rather than solid color fills
forbid: Retaining the original Green or Orange colors
Flattening the icon into a 2D blue shape
Removing the internal segmentation lines (making it a solid triangle)
Adding unrelated props like a TV set or film reel
generation_direction: 3D translucent ice sculpture of the Tencent Video logo. Shape: Three nested triangular bands forming a play button, extruded with thickness. Material: Pale cyan/ice blue crystal with subsurface scattering. Details: Embedded snowflake textures and tiny air bubbles inside the ice volume. Surface: Glossy, wet look with condensation droplets. Lighting: Soft studio lighting with caustics. Background: Pure white with a subtle contact shadow and melting water puddle at the base.
